about: New Gold's own Baby Lugia (own_species.py) cries Lugia's cry seven semitones higher: its own wave archive, 1310, Lugia's samples played at 15,750 Hz (import_cries.raised), as large as Lugia's and so within the cry player's heap. A level-12 Baby Lugia leads against a forced wild Geodude, and its cry, the last before the first command, starts (PlayCry's result, gDiagCryStarted). The field's RNG is pinned as in cry_added_species.json.
